name: Amantadine
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: Antiparkinsonian drug used for symptomatic management of Parkinson’s disease; relevant to neurodegenerative pharmacotherapy, not presented here as disease-modifying evidence.

name: Baclofen
papertitle: Tizanidine Versus Baclofen in the Treatment of Spasticity in Patients with Multiple Sclerosis
note: Used for spasticity in multiple sclerosis, a chronic neuroinflammatory demyelinating disease with neurodegenerative components; supported by symptomatic neurological use.

name: Benserazide
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: Peripheral DOPA decarboxylase inhibitor used with levodopa in Parkinson’s disease; treated here as part of standard antiparkinsonian pharmacotherapy.

name: Benzatropine
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: Anticholinergic antiparkinsonian agent used for tremor and parkinsonism; treated here as symptomatic treatment in a neurodegenerative movement disorder.

name: Biperiden
papertitle: Trihexyphenidyl, Biperiden, and Other Anticholinergics in the Treatment of Parkinson’s Disease
note: Anticholinergic used in Parkinson’s disease; included to represent symptomatic antiparkinsonian therapy rather than disease modification.

name: Bromocriptine
papertitle: Ropinirole versus bromocriptine in the treatment of early Parkinson's disease: A 6-month interim report of a 3-year study
note: Dopamine agonist clinically evaluated in early Parkinson’s disease; treated here as antiparkinsonian pharmacotherapy.

name: Cabergoline
papertitle: Long-term tolerability and efficacy of cabergoline, a new long-acting dopamine agonist, in Parkinson's disease
note: Dopamine agonist evaluated for Parkinson’s disease; used for its direct therapeutic use in a neurodegenerative movement disorder.

name: Curcumin
papertitle: Neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory effects of curcumin in Alzheimer's disease: Targeting neuroinflammation strategies
note: Natural polyphenol discussed as a neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory candidate in Alzheimer’s disease; treated here as an investigational neuroprotective compound.

name: Dantrolene
papertitle: Dantrolene, a treatment for Alzheimer disease?
note: Ryanodine-receptor modulator proposed for Alzheimer’s disease through calcium-homeostasis mechanisms; treated here as a repurposing/neuroprotection candidate, not an approved AD therapy.

name: Donepezil
papertitle: Donepezil for dementia due to Alzheimer's disease
note: Acetylcholinesterase inhibitor evaluated in Alzheimer’s disease dementia; treated here as approved symptomatic AD pharmacotherapy.

name: Entacapone
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: COMT inhibitor used as adjunct therapy in Parkinson’s disease; used for its role in dopaminergic treatment of a neurodegenerative disorder.

name: Galantamine
papertitle: Galantamine for Alzheimer's disease
note: Cholinesterase inhibitor evaluated in Alzheimer’s disease; treated here as symptomatic AD pharmacotherapy.

name: Ladostigil
papertitle: Low-dose ladostigil for mild cognitive impairment: A phase 2 placebo-controlled clinical trial
note: Ensayo clínico fase 2 de ladostigil en deterioro cognitivo leve como paso previo a EA; fármaco multifuncional (inhibidor de MAO/colinesterasa) con relevancia en EA y EP.

name: L-DOPA
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: Core dopamine-replacement therapy for Parkinson’s disease; treated here as standard symptomatic treatment of a neurodegenerative movement disorder.

name: Masitinib
papertitle: Masitinib as an add-on therapy to riluzole in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a randomized clinical trial
note: Clinically evaluated as add-on therapy to riluzole in ALS; treated here as an investigational motor-neuron-disease drug.

name: Melatonin
papertitle: The neuroprotective role of melatonin in neurological disorders
note: Review focused on melatonin neuroprotection in neurological disorders, including Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s disease; kept as mechanistic neuroprotective evidence rather than an approved disease-modifying therapy.

name: Memantine
papertitle: Memantine for dementia
note: NMDA receptor antagonist licensed for moderate-to-severe Alzheimer’s disease; treated here as approved symptomatic AD pharmacotherapy.

name: Piribedil
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: Dopamine agonist used in Parkinson’s disease; treated here as antiparkinsonian symptomatic therapy.

name: Pramipexole
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: Dopamine agonist used in Parkinson’s disease; treated here as standard symptomatic therapy for a neurodegenerative movement disorder.

name: Procyclidine
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: Anticholinergic used for parkinsonism; treated here as symptomatic antiparkinsonian pharmacotherapy.

name: Remacemide
papertitle: A controlled trial of remacemide hydrochloride in Huntington's disease
note: Antiglutamatergic compound clinically tested in Huntington’s disease; treated here as an investigational HD candidate.

name: Riluzole
papertitle: Riluzole for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)/motor neuron disease (MND)
note: ALS/MND therapy associated with survival benefit; treated here as a clinically established neurodegenerative-disease drug.

name: Rivastigmine
papertitle: Rivastigmine for Alzheimer's disease
note: Cholinesterase inhibitor evaluated for Alzheimer’s disease; treated here as symptomatic AD pharmacotherapy, also relevant to Parkinson’s disease dementia.

name: Ropinirole
papertitle: Ropinirole versus bromocriptine in the treatment of early Parkinson's disease: A 6-month interim report of a 3-year study
note: Dopamine agonist evaluated in early Parkinson’s disease; treated here as antiparkinsonian pharmacotherapy.

name: Selegiline
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: MAO-B inhibitor used in Parkinson’s disease; treated here as symptomatic dopaminergic therapy with neuroprotective interest historically discussed in PD.

name: Tacrine
papertitle: Tacrine for Alzheimer's disease
note: First-generation cholinesterase inhibitor evaluated for Alzheimer’s disease; used for historical AD pharmacotherapy, with hepatotoxicity limiting use.

name: Tetrabenazine
papertitle: Tetrabenazine for treatment of chorea associated with Huntington's disease and other potential indications
note: VMAT2 inhibitor used for chorea associated with Huntington’s disease; treated here as symptomatic HD therapy.

name: Tizanidine
papertitle: Tizanidine Versus Baclofen in the Treatment of Spasticity in Patients with Multiple Sclerosis
note: Used for spasticity in multiple sclerosis; treated here as symptomatic neurological treatment in a demyelinating neurodegenerative/neuroinflammatory condition.

name: Tolcapone
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: COMT inhibitor used in Parkinson’s disease; treated here as adjunct dopaminergic therapy, with safety limitations noted clinically.

name: Trihexyphenidyl
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: Anticholinergic antiparkinsonian drug; used for symptomatic treatment of Parkinsonian motor features.

name: Brexpiprazole
papertitle: Brexpiprazole for the Treatment of Agitation in Alzheimer Dementia: A Randomized Clinical Trial
note: Clinically tested and approved for agitation associated with Alzheimer dementia; treated here as symptomatic neuropsychiatric management in AD, not as neuroprotection.

name: Levitiracetam
papertitle: Effect of Levetiracetam on Cognition in Patients With Alzheimer Disease With and Without Epileptiform Activity: A Randomized Clinical Trial
note: Repurposing trial in Alzheimer’s disease-associated network hyperexcitability; treated here as an investigational AD neurophysiology-targeted therapy.

name: Atuzaginstat
papertitle: COR388 (atuzaginstat): an investigational gingipain inhibitor for the treatment of Alzheimer disease
note: Gingipain inhibitor developed for Alzheimer’s disease based on the P. gingivalis hypothesis; treated here as an investigational AD drug candidate.

name: Blarcamesine
papertitle: Blarcamesine for the treatment of Early Alzheimer's Disease: results from the ANAVEX2-73-AD-004 Phase IIB/III trial
note: Sigma-1 receptor agonist clinically evaluated in early Alzheimer’s disease; treated here as an investigational AD candidate.

name: Caffeine
papertitle: The Effect of Caffeine on the Risk and Progression of Parkinson's Disease: A Meta-Analysis
note: Epidemiological/meta-analytic evidence links caffeine exposure with Parkinson’s disease risk/progression; treated here as a neuroprotective candidate, not as an approved treatment.

name: Escitalopram
papertitle: Escitalopram for agitation in Alzheimer's dementia: a randomized controlled phase 3 trial
note: Ensayo fase 3 (S-CitAD) que evaluó escitalopram para la agitación en demencia por Alzheimer; tratado aquí como terapia neuropsiquiátrica sintomática en EA.

name: Hydralazine
papertitle: A randomized clinical trial evaluating Hydralazine's efficacy in early-stage Alzheimer's disease: The EHSAN Study
note: Repurposing candidate tested/proposed for early Alzheimer’s disease with preclinical neuroprotection rationale; treated here as investigational AD therapy.

name: Eicosapentaenoic Acid
papertitle: Omega-3 fatty acids and blood-based biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease and mild cognitive impairment: A randomized placebo-controlled trial
note: Omega-3 intervention evaluated in MCI/Alzheimer’s disease with biomarker outcomes; treated here as a nutraceutical/neuroprotective candidate.

name: Simufilam
papertitle: Phase 3 randomized clinical trials of simufilam in mild-to-moderate Alzheimer’s disease
note: Filamin-A-targeted investigational drug tested in phase 3 Alzheimer’s disease trials; treated here as AD drug-development evidence, with failed efficacy endpoints requiring caution.

note: ALZ-801 prodrug investigated in APOE4-associated early Alzheimer’s disease as an anti-Aβ oligomer agent; treated here as a disease-modifying candidate under clinical study.

name: Opicapone
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: COMT inhibitor used in Parkinson’s disease; treated here as adjunct symptomatic therapy for a neurodegenerative movement disorder.

name: Rotigotine
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: Dopamine agonist used in Parkinson’s disease; treated here as antiparkinsonian symptomatic pharmacotherapy.

name: Rasagiline
papertitle: Systematic Review on Parkinson’s Disease Medications, Emphasizing on Three Recently Approved Drugs to Control Parkinson’s Symptoms
note: MAO-B inhibitor used in Parkinson’s disease; treated here as dopaminergic symptomatic therapy with historical neuroprotective interest.

name: Pimavanserin
papertitle: Pimavanserin for patients with Parkinson's disease psychosis: a randomised, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial
note: 5-HT2A inverse agonist evaluated for Parkinson’s disease psychosis; treated here as symptomatic neuropsychiatric therapy in a neurodegenerative disorder.

name: Fingolimod
papertitle: Fingolimod as a Treatment in Neurologic Disorders Beyond Multiple Sclerosis
note: Approved for relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis and reviewed for neuroprotective potential beyond MS; treated here as neuroimmunomodulatory/neuroprotective candidate.
